runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on official-source origin, current publication/status readback, date/status separation, and explicit prevention of draft-policy or borough-target promotion to parcel-level truth.

sources.label: LBBD Local Plan 2037
sources.fact: Adopted 18 September 2024; sets the borough development vision to 2037 and is part of the Development Plan.

sources.label: LBBD Development Plan
sources.fact: Current development-plan page identifies the London Plan 2021, LBBD Local Plan 2037 and Joint Waste Development Plan as core plan documents used in planning decisions.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Chapter 4 Housing
sources.fact: Adopted London Plan; Table 4.1 gives Barking & Dagenham a 2019/20-2028/29 ten-year net housing target of 19,440 and Table 4.2 a small-sites component of 1,990.

sources.label: Draft London Plan consultation 2026
sources.fact: Current statutory consultation is open July-October 2026 and closes 17:00 on 15 October 2026; the plan remains draft and is not yet adopted.

sources.label: Mayoral Decision MD3515
sources.fact: Signed 9 July and published 16 July 2026; approved the Draft London Plan for 13-week statutory consultation starting 16 July 2026.

sources.label: Draft London Plan 2026 HN1
sources.fact: Draft Table 3.1 proposes Barking and Dagenham 2027/28-2036/37 housing targets of 8,558 brownfield plus 1,140 greenfield, total 9,698; draft status must be retained.

sources.label: Draft London Plan 2026 overview
sources.fact: Published 16 July 2026 as Draft London Plan; describes the emerging spatial strategy and does not replace the adopted 2021 Plan during consultation.

sources.label: Draft London Plan 2026 place visions
sources.fact: Draft chapter includes Brownfield First Opportunity Areas and place-based policies; these are emerging policy proposals, not adopted parcel entitlements.

sources.label: Draft London Plan 2026 annexes
sources.fact: Draft annexes include proposed monitoring KPIs, town-centre network and Green Belt sustainable-location tables; all retain draft status.

sources.label: LBBD monitoring and evidence library
sources.fact: Council monitoring page lists Authority Monitoring Report 2023-24 and explains AMRs show policy implementation and planning-document progress.

sources.label: LBBD Supplementary Planning Documents
sources.fact: Planning Obligations SPD was adopted 18 September 2024 and Thames Road SPD on 14 May 2025; draft SPDs remain distinct from adopted SPDs.

sources.label: Planning Data Brownfield land
sources.fact: 37,666 records from 354 providers; collector 23 July 2026; new data 22 July 2026; authoritative-source origin under OGL v3.0.

examples.result: LBBD Local Plan 2037 adoption date revalidated as 18 September 2024; current statutory local-plan weight retained.
Adopted London Plan 2021 Barking & Dagenham ten-year target revalidated at 19,440 net homes for 2019/20-2028/29; target is borough-level, not parcel capacity.
Draft London Plan 2026 Barking & Dagenham proposed target revalidated at 9,698 for 2027/28-2036/37 = 8,558 brownfield + 1,140 greenfield; explicitly tagged DRAFT.
Draft consultation window revalidated: 16 July to 15 October 2026; consultation does not equal adoption.
Current development-plan hierarchy retains London Plan 2021 + LBBD Local Plan 2037; emerging 2026 draft not substituted as adopted policy.
LBBD AMR 2023-24 confirmed as publicly listed monitoring evidence; monitoring output is borough-level and cannot prove individual parcel delivery.
Planning Data brownfield dataset freshness revalidated at collector 23 July 2026/new data 22 July 2026; register membership still does not establish exact parcel relation.
Draft Brownfield First Opportunity Area policy is retained as emerging-policy evidence only; no parcel score promotion without exact adopted-policy/site/geometry binding.
